phase: ECB QFA official-materiality acceptability gate for the narrow aggregate reference mode
purpose: Apply an independently sourced official ECB QFA materiality criterion to the already-retained exact-decimal aggregate diagnostics. The historical 0.1 million RON RMD gate remains an immutable strict diagnostic. This new gate can affect only aggregate reference-mode observability.

source_lineage: ECB 2013 QFA quality report: discrepancies below EUR 10 million explicitly acceptable in national data.

ECB 2024 QFA quality report: same internal-consistency family, all EU Member States checked, Romania included at 96% validation-rule compliance, and >EUR 10 million discrepancies remain the current materiality context.

currency_sufficiency_rule.required_condition: Every official quarterly RON-per-EUR rate must be > 1.
currency_sufficiency_rule.proof: If 1 EUR > 1 RON in every quarter, then EUR 10 million > RON 10 million. Therefore requiring each RMD discrepancy to be below RON 10 million is a strictly more conservative sufficient condition than the official EUR 10 million materiality rule.

retained_diagnostic_gate.pass_rule: Every absolute residual in all three retained internal-consistency diagnostics must be strictly less than 10 million RON.

promotion_rule: A PASS authorizes only a separate explicit promotion assessment for the narrow aggregate behaviour-over-time reference mode. Promotion may set sectoral_financial_positions to OBSERVED_SERIES_AVAILABLE only if the promotion assessment keeps the original bilateral Accounting Spine boundary partial and explicitly preserves the historical 0.1 million RON strict-gate FAIL as a diagnostic limitation.
failure_rule: Any missing FX quarter, any quarterly RON/EUR rate <=1, any missing retained diagnostic row, or any absolute internal-consistency residual >=10 million RON leaves the reference mode partial and returns to hold.

execution_policy.activation_condition: pull_request on frozen branch AND github.run_attempt > 1
execution_policy.live_access_scope: ECB EXR quarterly RON/EUR series only; OECD values are not re-accessed.
